title: Goodwill Credit: Conditions and Annual Limits of Issue
content:
Goodwill Credit, the service-recovery type of Gift Cards & Store Credit, is issued only as compensation decided under the Delivery Claims terms. A Goodwill Credit is issued only against a delivery claim whose status is approved or resolved, and the credit records that claim's number as its source. The claim's status is read from the delivery claim's record in the system.

## Annual limits

A customer receives at most three Goodwill Credits and at most 150.00 of Goodwill Credit in a trailing 12 months. Both limits count the customer's Goodwill Credits in any status by issue date over the trailing 12 calendar months: the count limit counts the credits, and the value limit totals their initial values.

- A credit that would exceed the value limit is issued only for the remaining allowance.
- When either limit is already reached, none is issued, and the Delivery Claims fallback for a reached goodwill cap applies instead.

## Decision table

| Delivery claim status | Goodwill Credits already issued in the trailing 12 months | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Any status other than approved or resolved | Any number | No Goodwill Credit is issued |
| Approved or resolved | Fewer than three, and below 150.00 in value | Issued, up to the remaining value allowance |
| Approved or resolved | Three already issued | None issued; the Delivery Claims fallback applies |
| Approved or resolved | 150.00 already issued | None issued; the Delivery Claims fallback applies |

## Worked allowance (hypothetical figures)

| Already issued in the trailing 12 months | Compensation decided | Goodwill Credit issued |
|---|---|---|
| Two credits totalling 120.00 | 50.00 | 30.00 (the remaining allowance) |
| One credit of 40.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Three credits totalling 60.00 | 20.00 | None — the count limit is reached |
